async def act(page):
    # Extract main content from the homepage
    content = await extract_main_content(page, '/')
    # Parse the content to find the third post
    import re
    lines = content.split('\n')
    posts = []
    current_title = None
    for line in lines:
        stripped_line = line.strip()
        if not stripped_line:
            continue
        # Detect title lines: they have multiple tabs and don't start with date patterns
        if '\t\t\t\t' in line and not re.match(r'^\t\w{3} \d+, \d{4}', line):
            title = re.sub(r'^\t+', '', line).strip()
            if title and title not in ['Watch, Read, Listen', 'Next Page→', '1', '2', '3', '…', '36']:
                current_title = title
        # Detect date lines: start with tab and month abbreviation
        elif re.match(r'^\t\w{3} \d+, \d{4}', line):
            date_match = re.search(r'\t(\w{3} \d+, \d{4})', line)
            if date_match and current_title:
                date = date_match.group(1)
                posts.append({'title': current_title, 'date': date})
                current_title = None
    # Check for third post
    if len(posts) >= 3:
        third_post = posts[2]
        return f"{third_post['date']}, {third_post['title']}"
    else:
        return "Not enough posts found."
